thread.title: Apple earnings to focus on iPhone X sales: Live blog - MarketWatch

author: Jeremy C. Owens   and   Emily Bary
title: Apple earnings to focus on iPhone X sales: Live blog - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc. is scheduled to report earnings after the market closes Thursday, with expectations of record revenue from holiday-season sales of the $1,000 iPhone X .
Beyond iPhone sales and revenue, Apple AAPL, +0.21% Chief Executive Tim Cook has plenty to talk about, including a controversy about older iPhones slowing down that has apparently led to federal investigations and Apple’s plans for billions in overseas profit that will cost it $38 billion in repatriation taxes under the new tax law. Apple’s title as most valuable company in the world could be at risk, as its closest competitor—Google parent company Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -0.05% GOOG, -0.19% —is about $40 billion behind and also announcing earnings Thursday afternoon.
Apple is expected to release its fiscal first-quarter earnings report about 4:30 p.m. Eastern time and hold a conference call beginning at 5 p.m., and MarketWatch will live-blog all of the action.
